decouverte.accroche: Find every scheme open to your monument.
decouverte.intro: You answer a few questions about your monument, its protection status and your project. We match your answers against more than 400 schemes, from the State to foundations, and show you the ones your project can apply for, with the rate and ceiling published by each funder.

avantages.detail: For each scheme: criteria, rate and ceiling, timetable, supporting documents, assessing body
avantages.prix: Prizes and calls for projects, searched just like grants
avantages.checklist: A checklist of the documents each funder asks for
avantages.documents: A document space, sorted by type, where anything you upload once serves all your applications

decouverte.note: A project is one piece of work. Re-roofing is one. Hosting a theatre company in residence is another. The funders are not the same.

public.question: Who is Monumia for?
public.reponse: Anyone with a place to maintain or bring to life: private owners, municipalities and local authorities.

nonProtege.question: My property is neither listed nor registered. Can I still get funding?
nonProtege.reponse: Very often, yes. Historic monuments make up only a small part of France’s heritage: unprotected monuments can also receive financial support. The questionnaire takes the exact situation of your property into account.

financements.question: What kinds of funding do you find?
financements.reponse: Public funding (the State and DRAC, regions, départements, municipalities), foundations and corporate sponsorship (Fondation du patrimoine, Dassault, Crédit Agricole, French Heritage Society…), as well as some European funding.

informatique.question: I’m not comfortable with computers. Is this for me?
informatique.reponse: Yes, Monumia was designed with you in mind. It guides you step by step, the questions are asked in plain language and every technical term is explained. And if you get stuck, we will answer you by email.

depot.question: Does Monumia submit applications on my behalf?
depot.reponse: No, and that is a deliberate choice. Monumia identifies the schemes, explains the rules, gathers your documents and prepares a complete application, ready to send. You stay in control of your applications; we save you dozens of hours of research and preparation.

prix.question: How much does it cost?
prix.reponse: Discovery is free, with no card required: one monument, two projects, full details of every scheme, the document space and help putting your applications together. Watch adds unlimited projects, the timeline, alerts before each closing date and the ability to invite collaborators. Multi-monument includes everything in Watch and brings several monuments together on a single dashboard. For the paid plans, book a meeting through our Calendly link or email us: we will talk it through with you and send you a tailored quote.

sources.question: Where does your information come from?
sources.reponse: Our database is built from funders’ official publications (government departments, local authorities, foundations) and kept up to date continuously. Each scheme page lists its sources and useful contacts.
